title: Beautiful private Nashville Duplex unit B
description:
Kick your feet up in this peaceful retreat. 8 minutes from downtown and 12 minutes from the airport. super quiet neighborhood so when you want to get away from all the noise you can escape easily. furnished with all the amenities you need with the feel of a home away from home. **Please note that this is a downstairs unit**

The space
This space is super cleaned and sanitized after every guest. If at any time you have any questions or problems feel free to contact me and I will do my best to fix it. This property sits in a very quiet neighborhood. please keep the noise to a moderate level. after 10 p.m. level should be low.

Guest access
This is a cozy duplex. GUEST THAT BOOK WILL BE DOWNSTAIRS IN UNIT B WITH PLENTY OF PRIVACY. The washer and dryer are available for your use. Feel free to get groceries and use the refrigerator while you are there. There are plenty of cooking utensils, pots and pans. A tea and coffee bar is available as a courtesy to you. Feel free to use the spices in the cabinet so you don't have to shop for them. Self checkin by keypad is at your convenience.
***There is a pet fee of $100 per stay***

Other things to note
**This unit is a downstairs unit** There is parking for 4 cars out front of the property. 1 space is available for guest. THERE ARE NO OVERNIGHT GUEST ALLOWED OTHER THAN THE GUEST ON THE RESERVATION. There is no smoking on this property if you choose to do so you can do it Outdoors. **There is a pet fee of $100 per stay**.  Please remove your shoes upon entry if you would be so kind. This is a very clean space and the energy from outside should not be brought into your safe space. please enjoy🙏🏽
